sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_AllowExteriorGenerator_tooltip: If enabled, generators will work on exterior tiles. \nThis will allow, for example, the powering of gas pumps.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_ChanceHasGas_tooltip: The chance of finding a vehicle with gas in its tank.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_ClothingLootNew_tooltip: All wearable items that are not containers.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_ConstructionPreventsLootRespawn_: Items will not respawn in buildings that players have barricaded or built in.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_ContainerLootNew_tooltip: Backpacks and other wearable/equippable containers, eg. cases.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_CookwareLootNew_tooltip: Items that are used in cooking, including those (eg. knives) which can be weapons. Does not include food.\nIncludes both usable and unusable items.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_DaysUntilMaximumDiminishedLoot_t: How long it takes for Maximum Diminished Loot Percentage to be reached.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_DaysUntilMaximumLooted: Days Until Max Looted Building Chance
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_DaysUntilMaximumLooted_tooltip: How long it takes for Maximum Looted Building Chance to be reached.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_ElecShut_tooltip: How long after the default start date (July 9, 1993) that the world's electricity turns off for good.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_Electricity_tooltip: Rate at which Electrical skill levels up.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_EnableTaintedWaterText_tooltip: If tainted water will show a warning marking it as such.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_FarmingLootNew_tooltip: Items and weapons which are used in both animal and plant agriculture, such as Seeds, Trowels, or Shovels.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_FoodLootNew_tooltip: Any food that can rot or spoil.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_FuelStationGasEmptyChance_toolti: The chance, as a percentage, that individual gas pumps will initially have no fuel.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_FuelStationGasInfinite_tooltip: If enabled, gas pumps will never run out of fuel
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_FuelStationGasMax_tooltip: The maximum amount of gasoline that can spawn in gas pumps.\nCheck the "Advanced" box below to use a custom amount.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_FuelStationGasMin_tooltip: The minimum amount of gasoline that can spawn in gas pumps.\nCheck the "Advanced" box below to use a custom amount.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_FuelStationGas_tooltip: How full gas tanks in stations will be initially.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_GeneratorFuelConsumption_tooltip: How much fuel is consumed by generators per in-game hour.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_GeneratorSpawning_tooltip: The chance of electrical generators spawning on the map.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_GeneratorVerticalPowerRange_tool: How many levels both above and below a generator it can provide with electricity.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_HoursForLootRespawn_tooltip: When greater than 0, after X hours, all containers in towns and trailer parks in the world will respawn loot.\nTo spawn loot a container must have been looted at least once. Loot respawn is not impacted by visibility or subsequent looting.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_InitialGas_tooltip: How full the gas tank of discovered vehicles will be.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_KeyLootNew_tooltip: Keys for buildings/cars, key rings, and locks.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_LiteratureLootNew_tooltip: All other items that can be read, including books, fliers, and newspapers.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_LootCannedFood_tooltip: Food that will never rot eg. canned food.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_LootContainer_tooltip: Backpacks and other wearable/equippable containers, eg. cases.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_LootFood_tooltip: Food that can rot eg. vegetables.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_LootItemRemovalList_tooltip: A comma-separated list of item types that won't spawn as ordinary loot.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_LootKey_tooltip: Keys for buildings/cars, key rings, and locks.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_LootOther_tooltip: Everything else. Also affects foraging for all items in Town/Road zones.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_LootRespawn_tooltip: How often items will respawn in already-looted containers in towns and trailer parks.\nItems will not respawn in player-made containers.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_LootSurvivalGears_tooltip: Seeds, Nails, Saws, Fishing Rods, various tools, etc.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_LootWeapon_tooltip: Hand-to-hand combat weapons eg. baseball bats.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_MaterialLootNew_tooltip: Items and weapons that are used as ingredients for crafting or building.\nThis is a general category that does not include items belonging to other categories such as Cookware or Medical. Does not include Tools.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_MaxItemsForLootRespawn_tooltip: Containers with a number of items greater, or equal to, this setting will not respawn.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_MaximumDiminishedLoot_tooltip: The maximum loot that won't spawn when Days Until Maximum Diminished Loot is reached.\nCheck the "Advanced" box below to use an exact percentage.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_MaximumFireFuelHours_tooltip: The maximum hours of fuel that can be placed in a campfire, wood stove etc.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_MaximumLootedBuildingRooms_toolt: If a building has more than this amount of rooms it will not be looted.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_MaximumLooted_tooltip: The chance that any building will already be looted when found.\nCheck the "Advanced" box below to use a custom number.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_MechanicsLootNew_tooltip: Vehicle parts and the tools needed to install them.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_MedicalLootNew_tooltip: Medicine, bandages and first aid tools.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_MementoLootNew_tooltip: Spiffo items, plushies, and other collectible keepsake items eg. Photos.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_OtherLootNew_tooltip: Everything else. Also affects foraging for all items in Town/Road zones.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_RecentlySurvivorVehicles_tooltip: Whether a player can discover a car that has been cared for\n after the Knox infection struck.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_RemoveStoryLoot_tooltip: If enabled, items on the Loot Item Removal List, or that have their rarity set to 'None', will not spawn in randomised world stories.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_RemoveZombieLoot_tooltip: If enabled, items on the Loot Item Removal List, or that have their rarity set to 'None', will not spawn worn by, or attached to, zombies.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_RuralLooted_tooltip: The chance that any rural building will already be looted when found.\nCheck the "Advanced" box below to use a custom number.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_SeenHoursPreventLootRespawn_tool: When greater than 0, loot will not respawn in zones that have been visited within this number of in-game hours.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_SkillBookLoot_tooltip: Books that provide skill XP multipliers.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_SurvivalGearsLootNew_tooltip: Fishing Rods, Tents, camping gear etc.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_ToolLootNew_tooltip: Items and weapons which are Tools but don't fit in other categories such as Mechanics or Farming.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_VehicleEasyUse_tooltip: Whether found vehicles are locked, need keys to start etc.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_VehicleStoryChance_tooltip: The chance of road stories (eg. police roadblocks) spawning.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_WaterShut_tooltip: How long after the default start date (July 9, 1993) that plumbing fixtures (eg. sinks) stop being infinite sources of water.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_WeaponLootNew_tooltip: Weapons that are not tools in other categories.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_ZCrawlUnderVehicle_tooltip: How often zombies can crawl under parked vehicles.
sandbox_keys_review.Sandbox_ZombiePopLootEffect_tooltip: If greater than 0, the spawn of loot is increased relative to the number of nearby zombies, \nwith the effect multiplied by this number.
